Dear Miss Yonge,
New Eng.

Dictionary
Mr. [Fitzedward Hall](../persons.html#2388) has given me a reference for Clidders to [Heir of Redclyffe](../books.html#15) ch. vii., which we cannot find.

Would it be possible for you to send me the quotation & with the proper reference?

Literary quotations for the word are not very easily got.

We know your hand well in the [earlier Dictionary material](../others.html#151), though it has not been my fortune to see it often in later times.

Yours very truly,
[J.A.H.

Murray ](../persons.html#1074)
